title: A constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on a limit of qcqs schemes descends to some stage (Stacks 09YU (3), essential surjectivity)
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(X_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{ii'}:X_i\to X_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], every $X_i$ being quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; let $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ be its limit, with projections $f_i:X\to X_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are an index $i\in I$, a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $\mathcal F_i$ on $(X_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i\cong\mathcal F$, where $f_i^{-1}$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. (This is the essential surjectivity half of Stacks, Lemma 09YU (3): 'the category of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ is the colimit of the categories of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $(X_i)_{\Et}$', there for a Noetherian ring $\Lambda$; it is stated here for finite $\Lambda$, the generality of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. The faithfulness and full faithfulness halves of 09YU are not part of this statement, but the source's proof of essential surjectivity uses full faithfulness to descend the map between two presentations.)

The argument is very similar ... using Lemma 095N (lemma-category-constructible-modules) instead of Lemma 09Y9. Details omitted.' (lines 12621-12625)

proof.text: Mathlib isAffineHom_π_app proves each projection affine for the given limit cone; compactSpace_of_isLimit and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated give qcqs of the limit. This avoids the existential replacement limit cone in the earlier plan.
Apply exists_affine_free_etale_presentation to F to obtain f, g and a colimiting cokernel cofork.
Apply exists_affine_free_etaleModule_arrow_descent to f and its affine families. Obtain a stage, constructible A,B, an arrow a, and a commuting square of pullback isomorphisms.
Convert hA and hB using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff; the proved source theorem IsConstructibleSheaf.cokernel makes cokernel a constructible. Convert back.

Etale.upperStar is already a left adjoint on ModuleCat-valued sheaves and preserves cokernels. Compose PreservesCokernel.iso with cokernel.mapIso for the commuting square and coconePointUniqueUpToIso for g's colimiting cofork. This gives the required isomorphism from the pullback of cokernel a to F.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 09YU (etale-cohomology.tex 12551-12625: the sets proof and 'details omitted' for modules), 095N, 03S8/03RZ, 09YQ, 03S6 and the existing nodes. Statement kept. Proof written out (by agent, Stacks omits the module case) in 8 steps following the sets proof: X qcqs and the Hom(j_{W!}Lambda_W,H)=H(W) bijection (free Yoneda leaf + sheafification); presentation of F (lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-presentation, 095N); descent of the affine etale U_k, V_j to one stage via lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-colimit (2) (which packages 01ZM + 07RP; the brief's 01ZM/07RP route is that node's own proof); pullback of the free sheaves (new node lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-free-etale-module, Stacks 03S6 for Lambda_W with the generating-section compatibility) and finite sums (prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact (3)); descent of the matrix of the presentation map through its sections t_j in P_0(V_j) (new node lem-weil-pbc-limit-pullback-sections-colimit, 09YQ in degree 0 as in the 'Fully faithful' paragraph; only its surjectivity and compatibility are used, faithfulness of 09YU is not needed); verification that the descended map pulls back to f (inverse-image-composition, linear by the module adjunction); constructibility of the cokernel F_i (lem-weil-pbc-etale-free-sheaf-constructible, thm-constructible-serre for extensions/cokernels, prop-constructible-pullback); right exactness of f_i^{-1}. Mathlib: no match (one more LeanSearch recorded); both new nodes searched with LeanSearch, LeanFinder/Loogle and grep, no match (Mathlib's PresheafOfModules pullback of free Yoneda objects, Presheaf/Pullback.lean:70, is the presheaf-level analogue of the new 03S6 node).
